description.value: Pender Hill Park is a nature reserve managed by the Sunshine Coast Regional District on the upper Sunshine Coast. The park occupies elevated terrain near Madeira Park and is likely accessed via Coastview Drive, offering natural area recreation in a coastal BC setting. Touring cyclists in the Pender Harbour area may find it a worthwhile side trip, though on-site facilities are unconfirmed.
